This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
which must be performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title 
block.

This 
pump is used to suction the sludge wasting water from the DAF tank and 
discharged it in the sludge thickner.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawey, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy

inspection & quality control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
